title: REDUCED FLASHING
why: His order: add all of this to Settings. The ACCESSIBILITY section gets REDUCED FLASHING, off as the game was. On, the bright flashes are toned down: the light of a blast, a shot or the Forge is smaller and shorter, every burst of sparks has half as many (the Forge sparks too), the muzzle flash on a gun is dimmer, and the lightning that lights the whole street is dimmer and lifts the fog less. It is only what is drawn: what a lightning bolt shows to the machines, the damage and the sounds are as they were. It changes at once and is saved with the profile; in the DEMO it holds for the session.
